description: Run an axe-core accessibility audit on the page currently open in the browser_* browser. Returns WCAG violations grouped by rule, most severe first, with CSS selectors, a short html excerpt and the fix for each element. Navigate first; re-run after a click/state change to audit dialogs or menus.

selector.description: Audit only this part of the page (CSS selector, e.g. 'main', '#cart-drawer'). Default: whole page.

tags.description: axe rule tags to run. Replaces the default (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa) — to add "best-practice" or "wcag2aaa", pass the defaults plus it.

name: playguard_a11y_audit
